card.name: Hyphen in in-line filter terms
card.fires_on: The hyphen and following part of a hyphenated compound describing infusion equipment, mostly "-line" in "in-line filter" and "-binding" in "low-protein-binding". It appears in IV administration instructions.

modes.label: in-line filter
modes.description: The "-line" after "in" when an in-line filter for infusion is described.
modes.example: ZEPZELCA can be administered with or without an in<<-line>> filter.

modes.label: low-protein-binding filter
modes.description: The "-binding" ending of "low-protein-binding" before a filter pore size.

modes.label: other equipment compounds
modes.description: Hyphenated parts such as "-on" or "pre-cut" in preparation supplies.

card.plain: It fires on the hyphenated part of filter and infusion-set terms like in-line and low-protein-binding in IV preparation instructions.
evidence: ZEPZELCA can be administered with or without an in<<-line>> filter.
